ctbids-48933-5719518.description:
A dazzling little explosion of vintage glamour! This distinctive 14K gold cocktail ring features a dramatic three-dimensional cluster of sparkling dark blue faceted gems arranged in an eye-catching starburst design.
The raised centerpiece showcases numerous individually prong-set dark blue stones surrounded by radiating gold spikes, creating a sculptural, celestial-inspired silhouette with wonderful depth and dimension. The combination of dark, glittering stones and warm gold gives this piece a sophisticated yet playful character.
Reminiscent of the bold Sputnik and atomic-age jewelry designs popular during the mid-20th century, this 14K ring weighing 7.29 grams makes a fabulous statement accessory for collectors of retro costume jewelry, lovers of Hollywood Regency glamour, and enthusiasts of unusual vintage-inspired designs.
Perfect for evening wear, cocktail parties, holiday celebrations, or adding a dramatic finishing touch to an eclectic jewelry collection. Its dimensional construction and distinctive silhouette also make it an appealing find for vintage jewelry resellers.
Condition: Pre-owned with possible surface wear and signs of previous handling. Two "14K" stamps and a diamond shaped makers mark on band, however, stone materials and age have not been verified. Please review photographs for details regarding gem settings and overall condition.

Natural Mineral & Fossil Collection
Arizona Petrified Wood and Quartz Crystal Specimens
Petrified Wood, Quartz Crystal
13" x 10" x 3" (Lot Dimensions)

This comprehensive mineral specimen lot features a diverse array of geological treasures, headlined by a large, polished round of petrified wood showcasing intricate growth rings and fossilized cellular detail. The collection includes a secondary block of Arizona petrified wood, complete with an original identification label, displaying vibrant ochre and sienna tones typical of the region's silicified forests. Complementing the fossilized wood is a significant clear quartz crystal cluster featuring multiple terminations and a bright, reflective luster, alongside two additional raw quartz specimens of varying forms.
Large polished petrified wood slab with visible growth rings and natural bark edge
Labeled Arizona petrified wood specimen with cut and polished display face
Substantial quartz crystal cluster with natural points and raw terminations
Total collection weight of 10 pounds
Condition:
Very good natural condition throughout. The primary slabs are polished to a high sheen on display faces while retaining natural textures on the reverse and edges. As natural specimens, these pieces contain inherent inclusions, fractures, and rough areas. No significant damage or repairs are noted. All items are structurally sound and display-ready.
